description: This file implements the RunC container management class, including container lifecycle operations (create, start, stop, delete), state retrieval, and configuration handling, utilizing the runc CLI tool and JSON configuration files.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Encapsulates the execution of runc commands, managing container creation, execution, deletion, and state retrieval, including configuration and environment variable inheritance.

classes.name: Runner::Info
classes.description: Represents the container state information, including PID and status, parsed from runc's state output.

classes.name: Runner::Config
classes.description: Represents the container configuration, including process environment variables, loaded from config.json.

classes.name: Runner::Config::ProcessData
classes.description: Holds environment variables for the container process.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Implements the container interface for a runc-based container, managing its lifecycle and querying status.

classes.name: RunCContainer::InternalPurge
classes.description: Stops and deletes the container if it is running.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new container with specified ID and bundle path using runc.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a command inside the container, optionally with parameters.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the container.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists all containers managed by runc.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with a specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory usage info of the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns CPU usage info of the container.
